provenance.scope: internal Luna policy-only review/repair; not human approval
reviewer_notes: Direct plan review and repair from the original owner policies and field catalogs; this is not raw unattended first-shot onboarding.
Schema and composition semantics are unchanged: conditions in one when object compose with AND, alternative when objects compose with OR, and rules are first-match in listed order.

Each plan starts with explicit owner data-gap guards where the policy requires insufficient_data; targeted unknown guards for unresolved non-data semantic conditions then stop to investigate before positive or quiet guards.
Cobalt keeps the policy's OR trigger and adds the explicit all-false quiet branch. Total or regional comparability missing is an OR condition, not an AND condition.
Maple treats missing required metrics as a distinct policy condition from uncertainty about a check. A claimed exception conflict is investigated before an approved exception can quiet the case.

Quartz compresses priority and reconciliation presence into explicit known-status checks, routes either missing or conflicting status to insufficient_data, and makes signed reconciliation an ignore override.

The policies do not state precedence for a valid approval/exception combined with missing required data. The repaired plans place the explicit missing-data guard before the override and record that ambiguity here rather than inventing a business rule.
The rejected provisional draft used a blanket unknown-first guard and is archived separately; this reviewed file replaces that ordering and is the experiment input.
No business-specific constants were added beyond the thresholds and field catalog supplied by the fixture policies. This file is experiment input, not a production default.

author_instructions: Compile the supplied owner policy once, without seeing measurements. Use only submit_plan. Numeric comparisons MUST use catalog numeric checks, not semantic questions. Semantic checks ask one condition against source text, with true/false/unknown. Use concise standalone conditions. Rules are ordered first-match; when is an OR list of AND dictionaries mapping check IDs to true/false/unknown. Explicitly handle missing/conflicting required evidence and exception priority. An unresolved earlier rule defers to investigate; it never silently falls through. Numeric absent values and uncertain semantic answers become unknown. Never add business conditions. Destinations are bound by code to policy.destinations, not generated. Default must follow the policy. No executable code or case-specific constants beyond policy thresholds. Submit once valid.
report_instructions: Run every recurring review sequentially using read_current then submit_report. Use the owner policy, current evidence and exact code-computed numeric checks. The compiled plan is available equally to both arms; owner policy is authoritative. Do not infer absent facts or causation. Write 30-70 words for an actionable report, shorter for quiet: significance, evidence, caveat and next step. Cite exact fact IDs. Stop only when all_periods_complete. Nothing is delivered.
